text: Confirmed and filed #6576 (open, owner-authored, agent-approved): resumable SCAN predicate can close its source cursor and reopen another table in the same work area; Copperfin continues the old loop body on replacement rows REPLACED1 and REPLACED2, while installed VFP9 SP2 COM aborts the equivalent PRG with error 1099 Procedure canceled. Source stores only work_area in ScanExpressionContinuation and re-resolves by area; issue links the VFP SCAN Language Reference and exact artifacts at /home/rich/temp/copperfin-scan-aba. Distinct sibling of #6251 SELECT cursor-generation fix; no production changes.
